items.source: Callback being invoked after a domain object is materialized from a Document when reading results.
items.translation: 在读取结果时，回调会在从Document反序列化域对象后被调用。

items.source: Callback being invoked after a Document is read from Elasticsearch and before it is converted into a domain object.
items.translation: 在从 Elasticsearch 读取Document之后、将其转换为领域对象之前，回调将被调用。

items.source: EntityCallback to populate auditing related fields on an entity about to be saved.
items.translation: EntityCallback，用于在即将保存实体时填充审计相关字段。

items.source: Entity callback triggered after save of an entity.
items.translation: 实体保存后触发的实体回调。

items.source: Callback being invoked before a domain object is converted to be persisted.
items.translation: 在将域对象转换为可持久化状态之前调用回调。
